metaDescription: How Used Slot Shop collects, uses, and protects your information.
title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: Last updated: 2026-07-31

paragraphs: Used Slot Shop ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.

sections.heading: What we collect
bullets: Information you submit via contact or quote forms (name, email, phone, state, message)
Transaction details required to process your order
Standard web analytics (pages visited, approximate location, device type)

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use your information to respond to inquiries, process orders, ship and service machines, and improve our site. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: Cookies & analytics
paragraphs: We may use first-party cookies and privacy-respecting analytics to understand how visitors use the site. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about this policy? Reach us at the email address or phone number listed on our Contact page.
